name: Dakiya
summary: COD order desk for online sellers: courier cash owed, return rate per city and statement matching
about: A dashboard for a Pakistani online store that ships cash-on-delivery parcels through several couriers. Track orders by courier, city and status, see how much cash each courier still owes, find the cities with the most returns, and reconcile courier payment statements line by line in PKR. Built for online clothing, beauty and gadget sellers.
how: Overview shows orders by status, delivered and return rates, cash with couriers and a live map where parcels travel from your warehouse to each city.
Book a COD order, then open it to scan it forward (in transit, out for delivery, delivered) or mark it returned with a reason. Print a parcel label.
Tap Ask to confirm to open a ready WhatsApp confirmation text (wa.me link) before dispatch, then mark the order confirmed.
Open Reconcile, pick a courier and its newest statement, and run Auto-match. Lines with a different amount or an unknown order number are flagged.
Drag an unknown statement line onto the right delivered order (or use Match), then Accept the statement to mark those orders as paid.
Cities ranks return rates and lets you switch a city to advance payment only; Returns tracks reasons and restocking.
